maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is SaaS subscriptions and payment processing for service SMBs, not repair, maintenance or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private service SMBs (home services, health, fitness) paying software subscriptions and payment fees; not government-funded.

serial_acquirer.reason: Built as a roll-up platform acquiring many vertical SaaS vendors (EverPro, EverHealth brands), though recent growth is also organic.

mission_critical.reason: Business management, scheduling, billing and payment software embedded in SMB daily operations; switching means migration, retraining and disruption.
